# Plan: engine-core

Goal: Port the parity-critical core of the engine — fold (packages/engine/src/core/fold.ts, ~1.5k lines), the event schema and envelope, the cursor — to Rust as one library exposed three ways: UniFFI bindings for the native Swift Mac app (sofar-cloud desktop-v2), wasm for the webapp and the Bun API, and the existing TS CLI wrapping it. The CLI, init, doctor, MCP and driver stay TypeScript around the core. Gate before any surface switches: the Rust fold deep-equals the TS fold on every real events.jsonl in this repo and in sofar-cloud (fold parity, the rule sofar-cloud D7 already enforces). Hook latency is not the motive (sofar status runs in ~50ms under node); one core across Swift, web and server is.
